title: BACHELORETTE PARTY SAUNA EXPERIENCE "BACHELORETTE SAUNA"

poem.title: Folk Song:
poem.line1: To the sauna I go, to the sauna I run,
poem.line2: In the sauna is my bride,
poem.line3: In the sauna is my bride,

description1: By tradition, a bachelorette party is a gathering of the bride-to-be's friends – a day to celebrate in style and do something unusual and exciting together.
description2: At SaimniekaPirts, the bride's friends book the sauna as part of the bachelorette celebration: to relax together and share rituals of beauty and renewal that wish the bride well and prepare her for married life.

details.master: Led by one certified sauna master

includedItems: Warming up together, with a wish-making ritual for the bride;
A vibroacoustic massage with willow whisks for the bride;
A relaxing whisking, with the friends helping the sauna master to heat and to make whisk compresses;
CLEANSING SCRUB – a cleansing rub with herbal mixtures that refreshes body and spirit;
The main whisking, just for the bride;
NOURISHING SCRUB – (agreed in advance) coffee, amber, clay, honey or another body treatment for the bride;

additional.rental: Sauna and herbal hot tub – 18€ / h (4 h included in the price)
